claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows fat tires with 'MAGISI' sidewall text, matching the described fat-tire folding bike.
Report lists only standard parts (saddle, grips, fork, brakes); no accessories (lock, pump, light, bell, rack, etc.) are mentioned or shown.

risks.risk: Gear/drivetrain presence and functionality unknown (single-speed vs multi-speed, shifting condition).
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of crankset, rear derailleur (if any), and a clip of pedaling/shifting.
risks.if_unproven: Price as base single-speed with unverified drivetrain condition.

risks.risk: Brake and suspension fork functionality not confirmed.
risks.proof: Video of brakes engaging and fork compressing under load.
Video of the bike being folded and unfolded, showing hinge lock engagement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as folding mechanism unverified/possibly loose.

risks.risk: Frame rust, dents, or paint damage hidden by angle or staged display.
risks.proof: Multiple close-up photos of frame joints, underside, and fork in daylight.

risks.risk: 'Complete accessories' claim unverified - could be an empty marketing phrase.
risks.proof: Photo listing all included accessories laid out next to the bike.
risks.if_unproven: Price as bike only, no accessories included.

risks.risk: Image may be a stock/shop promotional photo (watermark 'Sunny Best Sports'), not the actual unit for sale.
risks.proof: Fresh, unwatermarked photos of the specific bike being sold, including any identifying marks or serial number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unverified actual condition, treat as generic listing photo only.

risks.risk: Tire wear/pressure and overall mileage unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up of tire tread and a video of the bike being ridden briefly.

proof_requests: Current, unwatermarked photos of the actual bike for sale (not shop stock image).
Video of brakes and gears in use.
Close-up photos of frame joints and underside for rust/damage.
Photo of all accessories included, laid out separately.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type (fat-tire folding bike, brand Magisi), so it can be priced at worst case pending proof of condition, drivetrain, and the unverified 'complete accessories' claim.
